svg.aria-label: A grid of work units. Columns are groups of 20 dataset steps, 0–19 to 80–99 and onwards to step 4,000; rows are the four lanes, each a quarter of every step's 1,024 sequences. Each cell is one unit named by its group and lane, such as 000000-2.json. The highlighted unit, Unit(first=0, count=20, lane=2, lanes=4), is the third quarter of each batch at steps 0 to 19: 20 batches of 256 sequences. Any node can process any unit.
svg.text: A dataset step holds 1,024 sequences, sliced into four lanes of 256
A unit is one lane over 20 consecutive steps. Every node builds the same mapping from identifiers to units.
The third quarter of each batch at steps 0–19: 20 local batches of 256 sequences, one per step.
The full run has 800 units, 200 groups of 20 steps × 4 lanes. The lane names the data, not the node that trains it.
